This notebook will create cancer alliance plots comparing palbociclib and ribociclib use.



## Load the data

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
	warning =  FALSE, message = FALSE
)

# load some required packages for data carpentry and visualisation
require(ggplot2)
require(tidyverse)
require(gtsummary)
require(gt)
#require(ggalt)


# Get the dataset 
# Requires cleaned data
cdk46Data <- readRDS(here::here("data/cdk46_op_hosp_clean.RDS"))

# agregate the data to VTM & month for ICBs
cdk46Data |>
  # get the VTM (ingredient)
  separate_wider_delim(vmp_name, delim=" ", names = c("VTM", "strength", "form")) |>
  # summarise the data using month and VTM
  group_by(year_month, VTM, ICB_name) |>
  summarise(ddd=sum(ddd_quantity)) -> cdk46ICBData

head(cdk46ICBData)
```

## Text for article
```{r}
dd21 <- cdk46ICBData |>
  filter(year_month >= as.Date("2021-07-01")) |>
  filter(year_month <= as.Date("2021-12-31")) |>
  group_by(VTM) |>
  summarise(`DDD 2021`=sum(ddd))

dd24 <- cdk46ICBData |>
  filter(year_month >= as.Date("2024-01-01")) |>
  filter(year_month <= as.Date("2024-06-30")) |>
  group_by(VTM) |>
  summarise(`DDD 2024`=sum(ddd))

dd21 |>
  left_join(dd24)

```


```{r}

cdk46ICBData |>
  ungroup()|>
  filter(VTM == "Ribociclib") |>
  select(-VTM)|> 
  rename(Ribociclib = ddd) -> ribo

cdk46ICBData |>
  ungroup()|>
  filter(VTM == "Palbociclib") |>
  select(-VTM)|> 
  rename(Palbociclib = ddd)   -> palbo

ribo |>
  left_join(palbo) -> combinedData

```


```{r}
alliances <- read_csv(here::here("data/CancerAlliances.csv")) |>
  mutate(ICB = paste("NHS",toupper(ICS))) 


combinedData |>
  rename(ICB = ICB_name) |>
  mutate(ICB = str_remove(ICB, " INTEGRATED CARE BOARD")) |>
  # mutate(ICB = str_replace_all(ICB, " And ", " and ")) |>
  # mutate(ICB = str_replace_all(ICB, " Of ", " of ")) |>
  # mutate(ICB = str_replace_all(ICB, " The ", " the ")) |>
  # mutate(ICB = str_replace_all(ICB, "-", " ")) |>
  # mutate(ICB = str_replace_all(ICB, " On ", " on ")) |>
  # mutate(ICB = str_replace_all(ICB, " and Isle ", " and the Isle ")) |>
  left_join(alliances) -> combinedData

combinedData |>
  filter(year_month >= as.Date("2021-07-01") & year_month <= as.Date("2024-06-30") ) |>
  filter(year_month >= as.Date("2024-01-01") | year_month <= as.Date("2021-12-31") ) |>
  mutate(year = year(year_month)) |>
  select(-year_month, -ICB, -Region, -ICS) |>
  group_by(year, Cancer_Alliance) |>
  summarise_all(sum) |>
  mutate(ratio = Palbociclib / Ribociclib) |>
  select(-Ribociclib, - Palbociclib) |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "Cancer_Alliance", names_from = year, values_from = ratio) |>
  mutate(change = (`2024` - `2021`) / `2021`) -> cdkChanges

cdkChanges |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(columns = c( "2021", "2024"), decimals = 2) |>
  fmt_percent(columns = c( "change"), decimals = 1)  -> change_table

change_table

```



```{r}
## Draw some maps
### shape file from
#require(rgdal)
require(sf)
#shp <- readOGR(dsn = "map/Cancer_Alliances_July_2023_Boundaries/CAL_JUL_2023_EN_BFE.shp")
shp <- read_sf(here::here("data/map/Cancer_Alliances_July_2023_Boundaries/CAL_JUL_2023_EN_BFE.shp"))
### https://geoportal.statistics.gov.uk/datasets/ons::cancer-alliances-july-2023-boundaries-en-bfe-2/explore?location=52.724129%2C-2.487028%2C7.11

## Add percentage data to shapes
cdkChanges |>
  mutate(CAL23NM = str_remove(Cancer_Alliance, " Cancer Alliance")) |>
  mutate(CAL23NM = str_replace(CAL23NM, "East of England  South", "East of England - South")) |>
  mutate(CAL23NM = str_replace(CAL23NM, "East of England  North", "East of England - North")) |>
  mutate(CAL23NM = str_replace(CAL23NM, "Humber, Coast and Vale", "Humber and North Yorkshire")) |>
  mutate(CAL23NM = str_replace(CAL23NM, "RM Partners", "West London")) |>
  select(-Cancer_Alliance) -> cdkData

shp |>
  left_join(cdkData, by = c("CAL23NM" = "CAL23NM")) -> shp_with_data


ggplot(shp_with_data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = change), color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "red", high = "yellow", name='% Change', 
                      breaks = -0.25*0:4, 
                      labels = scales::percent(-0.25*0:4),
                      limits = c(-1,0))+
  ggtitle('Change in Palbociclib to Ribociclib Ratio', 'by Cancer Alliance\nbetween Jul-Dec 2021 and Jan-Jun 2024') +
  theme_void() -> changeMap



ggplot(shp_with_data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = log(`2021`)), color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "gray23", limits=c(0, 10), name='Palbociclib to Ribociclib Ratio')+
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(position = "bottom", title.position = "top", title.hjust=0.5))+
  ggtitle('July - December 2021')+
  theme_void()-> baselineMap

ggplot(shp_with_data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = log(`2024`)), color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "gray23", limits=c(0, 10), name='Palbociclib to Ribociclib Ratio')+
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(position = "bottom", title.position = "top", title.hjust=0.5))+
  ggtitle('January - June 2024')+
  theme_void() -> currentMap

lay <- rbind(c(1,1, 3,3,3),
             c(2,2, 3,3,3))

cdk46Plot <- gridExtra::grid.arrange(baselineMap, currentMap, changeMap,  layout_matrix = lay)

cdk46Plot

```


## Export plot for Journal
Exports the plots and saves the change table for the supplements

```{r}
ggsave(here::here("r/outputs/Palbo_Ribo_Ratio_Map.svg"), cdk46Plot, width = 8, height =6)
ggsave(here::here("r/outputs/Palbo_Ribo_Ratio_Map.png"), cdk46Plot, dpi = 350, width = 8, height =6)

saveRDS(change_table,here::here("r/r-notebook/change_table.RDS") )
```
